edits.marker: ## Retained consequence can exceed current evaluative use
edits.addition:
## Operative requirements and changing organizations

The [organizational-requirement reconstruction](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/ORGANIZATIONAL-REQUIREMENT-INTEGRATION.md) recognizes that the native process already contains condition-sensitive responses. Available precursor, damage and local-store occupancy change which reactions occur; copying, repair and capture change those conditions again. No separate success label enters the rates. This is operative significance in a causal sense; felt significance, represented purposes and ethical warrant require their own connected explanations.

Six possible continuations from the actual formed apparatus preserve its occupied parts and original support history. Wear opens a copying vacancy and copying closes it. After H loss, A copying restores occupation while changing the composition. That does not make the old composition the goal: existing selector formation already gives constituents different roles after reorganization. Actual source depletion can also leave repair enabled while removing its subsequent capture return. Which response supports which continuation must therefore be identified through its actual relations.

The completed acquired reader has a precise local limitation. Its cells are full, its phase is installed and no contact is pending; the declared successful event guards provide no rewrite, reset or reconstruction path. Native events preserve these fields. The source argument applies before eventual support exhaustion; the independently reconstructed 449 new native events and 115-event shared prefix supply finite witnesses, not a universal proof by enumeration. Earlier selector/updater revision and the separate acquired relay dependency remain positive results under their own laws.

For this branch the next specific connection is consequences changing retention or reconstruction of the formed control coupling itself. A supplied law is an input to this representation, not thereby external to generative reality. The branch helps revise the core's articulation toward activity transforming its own conditions and response scopes; it does not justify an endless requirement for further controllers or establish the goodness of whatever persists.

### Native response and the local acquisition lifecycle

The [operative-requirement review](ORGANIZATIONAL-REQUIREMENT-INTEGRATION.md) continues actual cuts of the material acquisition above without changing its law. Six independently reconstructed native words preserve complete apparatus states and differentiate vacancy closure, type composition, source-supported repair and installed-record persistence. Their 449 new native events share one 115-event prefix. A separate source/induction argument establishes that successful declared events cannot reopen the installed apparatus. This identifies a local missing reconstruction path while crediting native regulation already present. It neither splices the earlier renewable-selector law into this history nor retracts the separate acquired-relay continuation. Core/tree integration concerns the explanatory relationships those branches establish; it does not require every local implementation to become one concatenated run.

## Native response and apparatus lifecycle: subsequent source analysis

The [fixed six-history protocol](OPERATIVE-PROTOCOL.md), [producer](operative_response.py), [saved results](operative-results.json) and [independent receipt](operative-independent-check.json) extend actual assembly/installation cuts without changing the twenty-case source or evidence above. They contain 449 new native events and one shared 115-event prefix, counted once. Copying can close a vacancy while changing type composition; repair can remain enabled after actual source depletion; native events preserve acquired records. The successful event guards provide no reset or rewriting after reader installation. That last all-history claim is a source/induction argument, not an inference from six finite paths.

See the [research integration](../../../../../../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/ORGANIZATIONAL-REQUIREMENT-INTEGRATION.md) for the nondual interpretation, source constraints and preserved alternatives.
